questions.question: State the difference between a group and a period, and describe how properties change down a group and across a period.
questions.expected_answer: A group is a vertical column (18 groups); a period is a horizontal row (7 periods). Elements in the same group have similar chemical properties because they have the same number of outer electrons. Across a period from left to right, properties change gradually from metallic to non-metallic, ending with a noble gas.

questions.question: Classify sodium, sulfur and silicon as metal, non-metal or semi-metal and give one property that supports each classification.
questions.expected_answer: Sodium: metal, e.g. shiny when cut, good conductor of electricity, left of the staircase in Group 1. Sulfur: non-metal, e.g. dull, brittle yellow solid, poor conductor. Silicon: semi-metal, e.g. shiny but brittle, a semiconductor, on the staircase line.

questions.question: Iron has atomic number 26 and mass number 56. Determine the number of protons, electrons and neutrons in an iron atom.
questions.expected_answer: Protons: 26 (the atomic number). Electrons: 26 (equal to protons in a neutral atom). Neutrons: 56 − 26 = 30.
